note: ADR-0500 withdrew the URL-in-`--database` spelling, so the remote bundle must go through `--load <url>` (with `--database` URLs a usage error); the fetch itself follows ADR-0496's GitHub rewrite, https/.cl policy, and capped streaming staging, and the ephemeral scratch copy is released and removed after the load.

The `query` verb is a first-positional statement-session command taking `[STATEMENT] [--database PATH]` with `:memory:` as the default and no exit-after behavior, sharing the options block with help, and its usage-error exits carry the command did-you-mean.

Add the procedure with a CIP-287-style signature with no database argument, gated behind the `ontology` preview feature, always built in cypherlite-ontology, honoring implicit/explicit transaction rules, and listed in SHOW PROCEDURES (hidden while gated off).

Extend the re-arrival trail-existence rule in the frontier NFA while keeping the kernel's structural and answer-shape gates and the cost gate, bounding work with the existing re-arrival/work budget that falls through to the DFS, and checking the auto/nfa/walk engine switch routing.

Add once-only post-verb `--read-only`/`--follow` to `serve` using the existing ReadOnly/Follow opens shared by all surfaces, with a pre-verb usage error and the Docker entrypoint forwarding them as valueless flags; since ADR-0368 retired the standalone mcp bin, MCP gets these through `serve --mcp`.

Implement the `snapshot DATABASE --to|--from FILE.cl` exit-after verb on read-only source opens, a nonexistent destination cleaned up on failure, codec preserved, via snapshot_to_bundle/restore_from_bundle and no new Cargo feature.
